verdict.rationale: Ashby documents automation-adjacent features such as custom agents for repeated workflows, webhooks and Slack actions. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, change review, or rollback of automations. Versioning automations is a fair question for a recruiting platform with workflow automation, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
